hints.title: Date Component Segmentation
hints.text: Split the date string on hyphens to isolate year, month, and day integers.

hints.title: Radix 2 Conversion
hints.text: Convert each parsed integer into its binary representation without leading zeros.

hints.title: Hyphen Rejoining
hints.text: Join the three converted binary strings with hyphens to form the final result.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct integer parsing and binary conversion.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Over-complicating parsing when format is rigidly YYYY-MM-DD.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Simple string splitting and binary conversion.
